sentences.en: Please give me a pencil and some sheets of paper.
sentences.zh: 请给我一支铅笔和几张纸。

sentences.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
sentences.zh: 那边读报纸的是我叔叔。

sentences.en: It's a good paper, apart from a few spelling mistakes.
sentences.zh: 除了几个拼写错误，这篇文章不错。

senses.zh: 贴糊墙纸；[美俚]发交通违章传票
